name: File Action Type 3 Code
definition: Determines the type of file action.

ADDD.name: Add
ADDD.definition: Add a new record or file.

DELT.name: Delete
DELT.definition: Delete an existing record or file.

ENQR.name: Enquire
ENQR.definition: Request the content of an existing record or file.

REPL.name: Replace
REPL.definition: Add a new record or file if none exists or replace an existing record or file if one exists.

REQU.name: Request
REQU.definition: Request for a file or record.

UPDT.name: Update
UPDT.definition: Update an existing record or file.
